headline: GTA 6 leak points to a PC launch as early as Q1 2027
summary: GTA 6 will launch console-only, but a leak suggests a PC version could follow as early as the first quarter of 2027, a much shorter wait than GTA 5's PC port took.

claims.statement: GTA 6 will launch console-only, with a PC version expected as early as Q1 2027, according to a leak.

sources.quote: GTA 6 could come to PC as early as Q1 2027, leak claims
GTA 6, the biggest release of the year, will be console-only at launch, with a PC launch now expected within the first three months of 2027.

claims.statement: A PC port in early 2027 would be a much shorter wait than GTA 5's PC port took.

sources.quote: That would be a much smaller port time than GTA 5.
